messages:
Priya: Quick intake — need to capture scope & acceptance criteria for the 'tenant-scoped response budget' initiative. Problem: customers hit unpredictable per-tenant costs with multi-turn chat + heavy retrieval. We need a runtime config to bound expected token spend while preserving quality for ~95% of sessions.

Ken: Can you split explicit goals vs non-goals?

Priya: Goals:
- Define runtime config fields: max_context_cost, soft_budget_pct, fallback_model.
- Acceptance SLOs for latency, quality retention, cost delta.
- Eval harness and canary plan for rollout.

Non-goals:
- Not shipping billing UI in v1.
- Not changing global model catalog.
- Not doing per-tenant KMS changes.

Maya: For quality retention we should measure generation ROUGE / embedding-sim similarity on a representative prompt set. Propose: <3% drop in top-1 quality metric vs baseline for 95% of tenants.

Jules: Reliability: any fallback must not increase p99 beyond current p99 + 200ms. Need circuit-breaker traces for tenant-level throttles.

Ken: Infra impl notes — runtime config sketch: 
```json
{
  "max_context_cost": int, // token-cost units
  "soft_budget_pct": int, // percent threshold to soft-degrade
  "fallback_model": string
}
```
Runtime should switch to cached/KV variant when soft budget hits.

Alex: UX: show subtle banner when tenant hits budget and link to recommended plan. Not blocking v1 but include telemetry event for banner impressions.

Omar: CS: pilot customer (Acme) requested predictable cost for heavy retrievals. They want a 30-day pilot with per-tenant reporting. Owner: @Omar to coordinate.

Maya: Edge cases to call out:
- Extremely long context (>=200k tokens): drop oldest retrieval chunks before prompt tokens.
- Streaming sessions: if fallback triggers mid-stream, ensure partial responses are completed or aborted gracefully.
- Multi-tenant chains: avoid sharding KVs across tenant boundaries.

Ken: Concrete acceptance metrics:
- Cost: avg per-session token cost delta <= +10% for 90% tenants, <= +20% for 99% tenants.
- Quality: automated eval <3% drop on designated prompt set for 95% tenants.
- Latency: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms, p99 < baseline p99 + 200ms.
- Observability: per-tenant telemetry in Console (token spend, degradations, fallback rate).

Priya: Rollout plan:
- Dev + e2e/harness: 2w.
- Internal canary (5% traffic): 1w with nightly quality evals.
- Beta (Acme + 2 others): 30 days.
- GA after telemetry + 0 critical regressions (target ~8w from start).

Ken: Risks & mitigations:
- Incorrect cost accounting -> run simulated replay on historical traces before canary.
- Quality regressions for niche prompts -> gated evals & automatic rollback to baseline model.

Jules: Ops checklist before canary:
- tracing tags for tenant_id and budget_state.
- alert if fallback_rate > 2% sustained over 1h.
- dashboard tile for top-10 tenants by fallback_rate.

Maya: Tests for eval harness:
- regression prompts set A/B.
- long-context truncation correctness.
- streaming fallback consistency.

Omar: Follow-ups / owners:
- Priya: finalize PRD with config schema (this thread is the source).
- Ken: runtime impl & canary infra.
- Maya: eval harness integration.
- Jules: observability + alerts.
- Omar: recruit beta tenants.

Priya: I'll draft the PRD and ping for quick review by EOD tomorrow. Any objections to the acceptance numbers above? :raised_hands: 

Ken: fine from infra
Maya: :thumbsup:
Jules: +1
Omar: good from CS
Alex: OK — will mock banner + telemetry event payloads
